decision_rule.summary: The diagnosis is sustained heat load when cumulative exceedance, rolling 3-day heat, and warm-night fraction are all material while apparent temperature does not exceed peak air temperature.

criteria.name: Answer form and diagnosis
criteria.description: Returns compact JSON with the five numeric fields and identifies sustained heat load as the primary human-health pathway.
criteria.partial_credit: Award up to 2 points for the correct diagnosis with missing fields; award up to 1 point for valid JSON that omits the diagnosis label.

criteria.name: Cumulative heat-load computation
criteria.description: Computes heat load above 30 C as 11.8 C-days from the daily maximum-temperature sequence.
criteria.partial_credit: Award up to 3 points for the right formula with a small arithmetic or rounding error; award up to 2 points for counting hot days without summing degree exceedances.

criteria.name: Hottest 3-day mean computation
criteria.description: Computes the hottest 3-day Tmax mean as 33.9 C for 2021-06-27 through 2021-06-29.
criteria.partial_credit: Award up to 2 points for a correct rolling-window method with minor rounding or date imprecision.

criteria.name: Night recovery ratio
criteria.description: Computes the warm-night ratio as 3/7 = 0.429 using Tmin >= 16 C.
criteria.partial_credit: Award up to 2 points for the correct warm-night count with a denominator or rounding mistake.

criteria.name: Humid-heat disambiguation
criteria.description: Computes the peak apparent-minus-air delta as about -0.2 C and treats moisture amplification as weaker than the air-temperature heat-load pathway.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for the correct qualitative comparison without the numeric delta.

criteria.name: Population heat-load proxy
criteria.description: Computes the local population heat-load proxy as about 2072.8 person-C-days and treats it as an exposure-scaled proxy.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for multiplying the correct quantities but overstating what the proxy proves.

criteria.name: Temporal persistence
criteria.description: Uses the four-day Tmax >= 30 C run and limited overnight cooling to support the sustained-load interpretation.
criteria.partial_credit: Award this point only when persistence is tied to heat-health stress.

criteria.name: Competing shortcut rejection
criteria.description: Keeps peak-day-only, humid-heat, drought, fire/smoke, rainfall, visible-damage, and asset-count shortcuts secondary to the heat-time profile.
criteria.partial_credit: Award this point only when at least one tempting shortcut is rejected by a computed value.

provenance.notes: Computed from local event temperature and population records; no network access.
